title: Candidate GRBs Dataset B1
purpose: B1 dataset consists of the output produced by the anomaly detection model and contains the list of GRB candidates identified in the data. It is designed to collect and organize events flagged as anomalous, serving as the basis for subsequent validation and characterization analyses.

provenance.sources: Output of the anomaly detection model applied to Fermi-LAT data
provenance.processing: Generated by applying the trained anomaly detection model to the processed Fermi-LAT dataset, with candidate events selected based on anomaly scores.
provenance.derivations: Derived quantities include the sky pixel and the anomaly detection scores (prob and prob_stage2) produced by the model at different processing stages.

quality.validation: Candidates were produced by the trained anomaly detection model and verified through automated consistency checks on anomaly scores and event metadata. Data integrity verified through CSV file validation and statistical checks on key parameters.
limitations: The dataset may contain false positives, as anomaly detection does not guarantee astrophysical origin
Detection performance depends on the training domain and background representation used by the model
No spectral or likelihood-based validation is applied at this stage
quality.usageGuidance: This dataset is intended for candidate screening, follow-up validation analyses, and performance evaluation of post-detection selection pipelines.

access.reuseGuidance: Users must cite this dataset when using it in publications or derivative works. Commercial use is permitted. Modified versions should clearly indicate changes from the original dataset.
